method: pdftotext -layout; Table 7 columns from the widest row per page, wrapped cells joined; descriptions from the last column of the SSD2 2013 table
limitations: chemmon_status is Table 7's generic status. Business rules make some optional elements mandatory by domain or case (e.g. resLOQ, CCalpha); see the linked wiki page.
Descriptions are the generic SSD2 2013 definitions. ChemMon sub-elements of compound elements (name with a dot) have only their Table 7 label.

elements.name: localOrgId
elements.label: Local organisation identification code
elements.description: Unique identification of the local or regional or national organisation (Competent Authority or company affiliate) requesting the analysis.

elements.name: localOrgCountry
elements.label: Local organisation country
elements.description: Country where the local organisation is placed. (ISO 3166-1-alpha-2).

elements.name: localOrgInfo
elements.label: Local organisation additional information
elements.description: Additional specific information and comments on the local organisation depending on specific requirements of the different data collection domains.

elements.name: progId
elements.label: Sampling programme identification code
elements.description: Unique identification code of the programme or project for which the sampling unit was taken.

elements.name: progLegalRef
elements.label: Programme legal reference
elements.description: Reference to the legislation for the programme defined by programme code. Reference to the legislation on what to sample, how to evaluate the sample etc.

elements.name: sampStrategy
elements.label: Sampling strategy
elements.description: Sampling strategy describe how the sample was selected (ref. EUROSTAT - Typology of sampling strategy performed in the programme or project identified by programme code (e.g. objective and selective sampling)).

elements.name: progType
elements.label: Programme type
elements.description: Indicate the type of programme for which the samples have been collected (National, EU programme, Total diet study, Control and eradication programme).

elements.name: sampMethod
elements.label: Sampling method
elements.description: Reference to the method for sampling (e.g. EU legislation).

elements.name: sampler
elements.label: Sampler
elements.description: Define which organisation (private or public) is performing the sample.

elements.name: sampPoint
elements.label: Sampling point
elements.description: Point, in the food chain, where the sample was taken. (See Doc. ESTAT/F5/ES/155 "Data dictionary of activities of the establishments").

elements.name: progInfo
elements.label: Additional sampling programme information
elements.description: Additional specific information and comments on the sampling programme depending on specific requirements of the different data collection domains such as if the programme is used for the verification of the Salmonella reduction target, number of animal under the control program, total number of samples tested, etc.

elements.name: sampEventId
elements.label: Sampling event identification code
elements.description: Unique identification of the sampling event. The entity representing the sampling unit extracted at certain time from the sampled population, whose chemical or microbiological properties are the target of the sampling.

elements.name: sampUnitType
elements.label: Sampling unit type
elements.description: Define the type of sampling unit taken in this event: a batch, an animal, a flock, a herd, etc.

elements.name: sampUnitSize
elements.label: Sampling unit size
elements.description: It contains the size/amount of the sampling unit.

elements.name: sampUnitSizeUnit
elements.label: Sampling unit size unit
elements.description: It contains the Unit in which the sampling unit size is expressed.

elements.name: sampUnitIds
elements.label: Other sampling unit identifications
elements.description: Additional identification codes for the sampling unit, at a more detailed level than the sampling event ID e.g. herd code or animal ear tag number.

elements.name: sampEventInfo
elements.label: Additional sampling event information
elements.description: Additional information on the sampling event depending on specific requirements of the different data collection domains such as status of the holding, the vaccination status, the date and country of slaughtering, etc.

elements.name: sampId
elements.label: Sample taken identification code
elements.description: Identification code of the sample taken.

elements.name: repCountry
elements.label: Reporting country
elements.description: The country the reported data refer to (ISO 3166-1-alpha-2).

elements.name: sampCountry
elements.label: Country of sampling
elements.description: Country where the sample was taken for laboratory testing (ISO 3166-1-alpha-2).

elements.name: sampArea
elements.label: Area of sampling
elements.description: Area where the sample was collected (Nomenclature of territorial units for statistics - NUTS - coding system valid only for EEA and Switzerland).

elements.name: repYear
elements.label: Reporting year
elements.description: The year the reported data refer to.

elements.name: sampY
elements.label: Year of sampling
elements.description: Year of sampling. In case the sampling has been performed over a period of time the start date (as year) of sampling should be reported.

elements.name: sampM
elements.label: Month of sampling
elements.description: Month of sampling. In case the sampling has been performed over a period of time the start date (as month) of sampling should be reported.

elements.name: sampD
elements.label: Day of sampling
elements.description: Day of sampling. In case the sampling has been performed over a period of time the start date (as day) of sampling should be reported.

elements.name: sampSize
elements.label: Sample taken size
elements.description: Total size/amount of the sample.

elements.name: sampSizeUnit
elements.label: Sample taken size unit
elements.description: Unit in which the size/amount of the sample is expressed.

elements.name: sampMatType
elements.label: Type of matrix
elements.description: Type of sample taken (e.g. food, food stimulants, animal, feed, environment; food contact material), identifying the sub-domain of the matrix catalogue to be used.

elements.name: sampMatCode
elements.label: Coded description of the matrix of the sample taken
elements.description: Description of the sample taken characteristics using the FoodEx2 catalogue.

elements.name: sampMatText
elements.label: Text description of the matrix of the sample taken
elements.description: Description of the sample taken characteristics using free text.

elements.name: origCountry
elements.label: Country of origin of the sample taken
elements.description: Country of origin of the sample taken (ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 country code).

elements.name: origArea
elements.label: Area of origin of the sample taken
elements.description: Area of origin of the sample taken (Nomenclature of territorial units for statistics - NUTS - coding system valid only for EEA and Switzerland).

elements.name: origFishAreaCode
elements.label: Area of origin for fisheries or aquaculture activities code of the sample taken
elements.description: Fisheries or aquaculture area specifying the origin of the sample (FAO Fisheries areas).

elements.name: origFishAreaText
elements.label: Area of origin for fisheries or aquaculture activities text of the sample taken
elements.description: Fisheries or aquaculture area specified in free text.

elements.name: procCountry
elements.label: Country of processing of the sample taken
elements.description: Country where the food was processed (ISO 3166-1-alpha-2).

elements.name: procArea
elements.label: Area of processing of the sample taken
elements.description: Area of product processing (Nomenclature of territorial units for statistics - NUTS - coding system valid only for EEA and Switzerland).

elements.name: sampMatInfo
elements.label: Additional information on the matrix sampled
elements.ssd1_name: prodCom, prodY, prodM, prodD, expiryY, expiryM, expiryD, prodManuf, prodBrandName
elements.description: Additional specific information and comments on the matrix sampled, depending on specific requirements of the different data collection domains.

elements.name: sampAnId
elements.label: Sample analysed identification code
elements.description: Identification code of the analysed sample, by default the same as the sampId.

elements.name: sampAnRefTime
elements.label: Sample analysis reference time
elements.description: Define the time at which the sample was analysed e.g. 'analysed at arrival to the laboratory', 'analysed at the end of shelf-life' (according to European legislation on microbiological criteria Reg. 2073/2005).

elements.name: analysisY
elements.label: Year of analysis
elements.description: Year when the analysis was completed.

elements.name: analysisM
elements.label: Month of analysis
elements.description: Month when the analysis was completed.

elements.name: analysisD
elements.label: Day of analysis
elements.description: Day when the analysis was completed.

elements.name: sampAnInfo
elements.label: Additional information on the sample analysed
elements.description: Additional specific information and comments on the sample analysed depending on specific requirements of the different data collection domains.

elements.name: anMatCode
elements.label: Coded description of the analysed matrix
elements.description: Encoding of the matrix analysed characteristics using the FoodEx2 catalogue. By default this element has the same value as "sampMatCode".

elements.name: anMatText
elements.label: Text description of the matrix analysed
elements.description: Description of the matrix analysed characteristics using free text.

elements.name: anMatInfo
elements.label: Additional information on the analysed matrix
elements.description: Additional specific information and comments on the matrix analysed depending on specific requirements of the different data collection domains.

elements.name: anPortSeq
elements.label: Sample analysed portion sequence
elements.description: Sequence number (e.g. 1, 2, 3) reflecting the sample analysed portion actually under analysis. The default value is 1.

elements.name: anPortSize
elements.label: Sample analysed portion size
elements.description: Size / amount of the sample analysed portion, i.e. amount of sample weight for analysis (weight of test portion).

elements.name: anPortSizeUnit
elements.label: Sample analysed portion size unit
elements.description: Unit in which the size of the sample analysed portion is expressed.

elements.name: anPortInfo
elements.label: Additional information on the sample analysed portion
elements.description: Additional information and comments on the sample analysed portion depending on specific requirements of the different data collection domains.

elements.name: isolId
elements.label: Isolate identification
elements.description: Identification code used to group an isolate identification with antimicrobial susceptibility tests performed on the same isolate.

elements.name: isolParamCode
elements.label: Coded description of the isolate
elements.description: Encoding of the isolate parameter code according to the PARAM catalogue. It is used to report the speciation or serotyping of the isolate.

elements.name: isolParamText
elements.label: Text description of the isolate
elements.description: Description of the isolate parameter (e.g. speciation/ serotyping) using free text.

elements.name: isolInfo
elements.label: Additional information on the isolate
elements.description: Additional specific information and comments on the isolate depending on specific requirements of the different data collection domains.

elements.name: labId
elements.label: Laboratory identification code
elements.description: Identification code of the laboratory (National laboratory code if available). This code should be nationally unique and consistent through all data domain transmissions.

elements.name: labAccred
elements.label: Laboratory accreditation
elements.description: The accreditation status of the laboratory and its reference procedure.

elements.name: labCountry
elements.label: Laboratory country
elements.description: Country where the laboratory is located (ISO 3166-1-alpha-2).

elements.name: labInfo
elements.label: Additional information on the laboratory
elements.description: Additional specific information and comments on the laboratory (e.g. total number of isolates available in the laboratory) depending on specific requirements of the different data collection domains.

elements.name: paramType
elements.label: Type of parameter
elements.description: Define if the parameter reported is an individual residue/ analyte, a summed residue definition or part of a summed residue definition.

elements.name: paramCode
elements.label: Coded description of the parameter
elements.description: Encoding of the parameter/ analyte according to the PARAM catalogue.

elements.name: paramText
elements.label: Parameter text
elements.description: Description of the parameter/ analyte using free text.

elements.name: anMethRefId
elements.label: Analytical method identification
elements.description: Identifier for the method used in the laboratory.

elements.name: anMethRefCode
elements.label: Analytical method reference code
elements.description: When validated methods are used, the official reference code should be provided.

elements.name: anMethType
elements.label: Analytical method type
elements.description: Type of analytical method used.

elements.name: anMethCode
elements.label: Analytical method code
elements.description: Encoding of the method or instrument used from the ANLYMD catalogue.

elements.name: anMethText
elements.label: Analytical method text
elements.description: Description of the method or instrument using free text, particularly if 'other' was reported for 'Analytical method code'.

elements.name: anMethInfo
elements.label: Additional information on the analytical method
elements.description: Additional specific information and comments on the analytical method depending on specific requirements of the different data collection domains such as disk concentration and diameter for antimicrobial resistance diffusion method, method sensitivity and method specificity, migration time, migration temperature, etc....

elements.name: resId
elements.label: Result identification code
elements.description: Identification code of an analytical result (a row of the data table) in the transmitted file. The result identification code must be maintained at organisation level and it will be used in further updated/deletion operation from the senders.

elements.name: accredProc
elements.label: Accreditation procedure for the analytical method
elements.description: The accreditation status of the analytical method used and its reference procedure.

elements.name: resUnit
elements.label: Result unit
elements.description: Unit of measurement for the values reported in 'Result LOD', 'Result LOQ', 'ResLLWR', 'ResULWR', 'CC alpha', 'CC beta', 'Result value', 'Result value uncertainty standard deviation, 'Result value uncertainty', 'Limit for the result evaluation' and 'Limit for the result evaluation (High limit)'.

elements.name: resLOD
elements.label: Result LOD
elements.description: Limit of detection expressed in the unit specified by the element 'Result unit'.

elements.name: resLOQ
elements.label: Result LOQ
elements.description: Limit of quantification expressed in the unit specified by the element 'Result unit'.

elements.name: resLLWR
elements.label: Result lower limit of the working range
elements.description: Lower limit of the working range expressed in the unit specified by the element 'Result unit'.

elements.name: resULWR
elements.label: Result upper limit of the working range
elements.description: Upper limit of the working range expressed in the unit specified by the element 'Result unit'.

elements.name: CCalpha
elements.label: CC alpha
elements.description: CC alpha value (decision limit) expressed in the unit specified by the element 'Result unit'.

elements.name: CCbeta
elements.label: CC beta
elements.description: CC beta value (detection capability) expressed in the unit specified by the element 'Result unit'.

elements.name: resVal
elements.label: Result value
elements.description: The result of the analytical measure expressed in the unit specified by the element 'Result unit'.

elements.name: resValRec
elements.label: Result value recovery rate
elements.description: Recovery value associated with the concentration measurement expressed as a percentage (%). i.e. report 100 for 100 %.

elements.name: resValRecCorr
elements.label: Result value corrected for recovery
elements.description: Define if the result value has been corrected for recovery.

elements.name: exprResPerc
elements.label: Expression of result percentage
elements.description: This compound field can be used to report the percentage of a measured specific matrix component (e.g. fat, alcohol, moisture) used as reference to express the analytical result (e.g. on fat basis, on alcohol basis and on dry weight basis).

elements.name: exprResType
elements.label: Expression of result type
elements.description: Code to describe how the result has been expressed: whole weight, fat weight, dry weight, etc.

elements.name: resQualValue
elements.label: Result qualitative value
elements.description: This field should be completed only if the result value is qualitative e.g. positive/ present or negative/ absent. In this case the element 'Result value' should be left blank.

elements.name: resType
elements.label: Type of result
elements.description: Indicate the type of result, whether it could be quantified/determined or not.

elements.name: resValUncert
elements.label: Result value uncertainty
elements.description: Indicate the expanded uncertainty value (usually 95% confidence interval) associated with the measurement expressed in the unit reported in the field 'Result unit'.

elements.name: resValUncertSD
elements.label: Result value uncertainty standard deviation
elements.description: Standard deviation for the uncertainty of measurement.

elements.name: resRefId
elements.label: Result reference identification
elements.description: When the result is a complex structure, the identification code to the external structure is stored here (e.g. molecular typing images).

elements.name: resInfo.notSummed
elements.label: Indicates LOQ should be calculated during the submission process

elements.name: evalLowLimit
elements.label: Limit for the result evaluation
elements.description: Report the reference or legal limit, limit or cut-off value for the parameter/analyte for the relevant matrix or the lower level of threeclass evaluation limit analyte. It is expressed in the unit specified by the element "Result unit".

elements.name: evalHighLimit
elements.label: Limit for the result evaluation (high limit)
elements.description: Report the higher legal limit of the analyte for the three-class evaluation limit analyte. It is expressed in the unit specified by the element "Result unit".

elements.name: evalLimitType
elements.label: Type of limit for the result evaluation
elements.description: Type of legal limit used to evaluate the result. ML, MRPL, MRL, action limit, cut-off value etc.

elements.name: evalCode
elements.label: Evaluation of the result
elements.description: Evaluation of the result. If the result exceeds a limit specified above or contains the evaluation on Sampling Event, Sample Taken, or Sample Analysed as indicated by evalLowLimit (N.01).

elements.name: actTakenCode
elements.label: Action taken
elements.description: Describe any follow-up actions taken as a result higher than the legal limit.
